## View/viewer semantics (recorded)

- **Seal X-07:** every phase-2 page renders fixture packets only;
  `fixture: true` in entry and doc for gated schemas (the receipt index
  is a strict codec — its entry is marked, the doc cannot carry the
  member); public profile renders publication-pending states everywhere.
- **Dormant viewer:** no request before an explicit click; the fetch
  URL is generator-stamped from index `repo`/`revision`/`path` joined to
  the declared origin; sha256 verified before any render; mismatch →
  `refused{sha256_mismatch}`; transcript bytes render via `textContent`
  with ANSI stripped — `<script>` fixtures are inert and never enter
  the HTML at all (only sha256 + bytes are committed).
- **No browser arithmetic:** site.js unchanged; viewer.js fetches +
  verifies + prints, never computes a value.
- **Pilot never ranks:** name-sorted rows, the fixed label; checker leg
  fails any band/group/ordering mark.
- **Typed absent states:** `not computed — R=1`, `not computed` for
  absent `harness_excess`, `undefined (0 solves)`, packet
  `refused{UnresolvedCell}` + all-planned bounds — all verbatim.

## Deviations / notes

- `hh-pilot-measure/1` is a declared-fixture schema spelling (the §6.6
  pilot packet's producer lands at R6.40; the URL map keeps awaiting
  FP-S). Chosen over `hh-experiment-slot/1` because the pilot page's
  contract is per-arm measures, not slot records.
- The receipt-index fixture is codec-strict (no `fixture` member); the
  seal covers it via the `p2_live` input-set gate instead.
- `test_sitepages.py` was pre-existing broken on main since R6.6
  (`RECORD_BANNED` moved to `claims-lexicon.json`) — repaired in-place;
  recorded per the fix-it rule for batteries the ticket requires green.
- `cargo clippy -p hharness-eval --tests -- -D warnings` reports 9
  pre-existing lib lints (untouched by this change; prior-art note 8).
- Basis-A attempt-1 per-task coverage is not carried by the xcheck
  packet (aggregate 16/30 only) — rendered `unrostered`, not invented.
- Size: ~1.7k changed source/test lines incl. fixture data + generated
  site-data — over the ≤1600 trigger; recorded, not halted (XO-03).
- The stage split landed interleaved in shared files; the green
  checkpoint (`a08e53d8`) precedes the verification commit (`fd50022e`).
